sections.heading: Overview
bullets: A storm fight across 5 sub-phases with platform transitions at 80% and 60%, escalating from stack-and-break to serious wind hazards. 9-minute enrage.

sections.heading: Phase 1 (100% → 80%) — Electrical Repulsion
bullets: Stack in front of Sabir to build Violent Currents stacks (boosts your damage). At 90% she gets a breakbar and starts a continuous knockback while dropping orange lines (Dynamic Deterrent) — break the bar fast with CC, using the Flash Discharge action key.
Once the bar breaks, spread out — the detonation circles that follow shouldn't overlap on anyone.

sections.heading: Phase 3 (80% → 60%) — wind hazards
bullets: Circling tornadoes strip your Violent Currents stacks.
Unbridled Tempest (at 75%): a lethal wind wall — survive it by riding a tornado up and over, teleporting through with Flash Discharge, or using a death-prevention skill. You cannot outrun it on foot.

sections.heading: Phase 5 (60% → 0%) — advanced mechanics
bullets: Ion Shield: a fast-refilling breakbar needing synchronized CC — the commander waits for ~6 players to have their action key up, then calls a simultaneous Flash Discharge.
Titanic Twister (from 50%): a huge orange tornado rotating clockwise — direct contact downs you, and being downed near it risks a full kill.
Fury of the Storm (at 50%): an expanding orange square — get into one of the two corner safe bubbles before it reaches the edge, or you go down.
Paralyzing Wisps (from 40%, more every 10%): side platforms spawn wisps — designated players glide over, break their bar, and kill them before they respawn 40 seconds later.

sections.heading: Enrage
bullets: 9:00 — Sabir deals +200% damage past this point.
